purpose: Thirty reusable, implementation-oriented remedies keyed to the issue taxonomy. Adapt to framework, user research and product constraints.

recipes.when_to_use: Undifferentiated options without selection criteria
recipes.implementation: Represent meaningful attributes, expose compare/filter/sort, identify defensible default and why. Keep full alternative set accessible.
recipes.acceptance_test: A novice chooses the correct option and can locate an uncommon alternative.
recipes.failure_modes: Hidden prices, misleading badges or fake scarcity.

recipes.when_to_use: A multi-page flow requires recollection
recipes.implementation: Keep query, selection, prior decisions and summary available in place; persist back/forward state.
recipes.acceptance_test: After interruption, users continue correctly without backtracking.
recipes.failure_modes: Exposing private input on shared surfaces.

recipes.when_to_use: Users repeat known facts or compute derived values
recipes.implementation: Pre-fill trustworthy values and calculate deterministic output; mark assumptions and allow editing before commitment.
recipes.acceptance_test: Completion requires less manual entry with no rise in uncorrectable errors.
recipes.failure_modes: Unreviewable financial/legal/identity decisions.

recipes.when_to_use: Users cannot locate features from sidebar labels
recipes.implementation: Use domain terms, meaningful section groupings, stable menu locations, active state, breadcrumb/deep link support.
recipes.acceptance_test: First-click/tree-test findability rises for representative tasks.
recipes.failure_modes: Organizing by internal architecture or arbitrary alphabetization.

recipes.when_to_use: Browsing details loses list context
recipes.implementation: Persist filtering, sorting, selection and scroll intent; implement real browser navigation.
recipes.acceptance_test: After viewing details, back returns to the same result set and relevant position.
recipes.failure_modes: Broken deep links or stale URLs.

recipes.when_to_use: Redesign violates user habits
recipes.implementation: Introduce changed patterns with explicit labels, optional transition aid and route from old entry points.
recipes.acceptance_test: Existing users complete habitual tasks without retraining.
recipes.failure_modes: Indefinite duplicate interfaces or forced tours.

recipes.when_to_use: Labels, controls and help text appear unrelated
recipes.implementation: Use consistent within-group vs between-group spacing, headings, accessible field association and simple surfaces.
recipes.acceptance_test: Users identify correct relationships at 320px and wide viewport.
recipes.failure_modes: Card borders around each field creating noise.

recipes.when_to_use: Everything looks equally important
recipes.implementation: Give one critical action a distinct but consistent visual treatment and position it in the task context.
recipes.acceptance_test: Users locate it rapidly without misreading destructive/secondary actions.
recipes.failure_modes: Contradictory emphasis, color-only meaning.

recipes.when_to_use: An icon or style hides clickable behavior
recipes.implementation: Use recognizable semantics, labeled uncommon icons, explicit link/button style and clear disabled/selected/error states.
recipes.acceptance_test: Users predict click outcome before activation.
recipes.failure_modes: Decorative lookalike controls or icon-only jargon.

recipes.when_to_use: Small or adjacent hit targets produce errors
recipes.implementation: Increase actionable area, separate dangerous/adjacent actions and follow applicable WCAG target rules.
recipes.acceptance_test: Pointer/touch errors decrease and keyboard remains available.
recipes.failure_modes: Overlapping invisible target boxes.

recipes.when_to_use: Custom clickable div requires nonstandard behavior
recipes.implementation: Use semantic link/button/input and preserve focus, keyboard, accessible name/role/state; use APG for composites.
recipes.acceptance_test: Tab/Enter/Space and screen reader match expected behavior.
recipes.failure_modes: Adding ARIA to nonfunctional elements without keyboard support.

recipes.when_to_use: Double taps repeat a critical action
recipes.implementation: Model pending/success/failure state, guard duplicate commits and expose cancellation or safe retry where supported.
recipes.acceptance_test: Repeated click during slow operation yields exactly intended outcome.
recipes.failure_modes: Silently disabling the only recovery mechanism.

recipes.when_to_use: Fields reject alternate harmless formatting
recipes.implementation: Normalize benign spacing/case/separators, validate canonical meaning and describe constraints only when needed.
recipes.acceptance_test: Common valid formatting succeeds; ambiguous/hostile values fail safely.
recipes.failure_modes: Silent value changes that alter semantics.

recipes.when_to_use: Error wipes entry or says only Invalid
recipes.implementation: Preserve draft, attach specific inline messages, focus/summarize error and return user to correct field.
recipes.acceptance_test: User fixes error without reentering unrelated data.
recipes.failure_modes: Error shown only with red color or toast.

recipes.when_to_use: Required info already exists or could be derived
recipes.implementation: Prefill cautiously, show source and editable state, summarize consequential values before submit.
recipes.acceptance_test: Task shortens without surprises about amounts or identity.
recipes.failure_modes: Nonconsensual reuse or silent inference.

recipes.when_to_use: Save action appears inert or success uncertain
recipes.implementation: Acknowledge pending immediately, track durable completion, show precise result and preserve safe retry.
recipes.acceptance_test: Users distinguish saving vs saved under slow and failed network.
recipes.failure_modes: Success toast issued before persistence.

recipes.when_to_use: Long task has spinner with no useful context
recipes.implementation: Show true percentage if measurable, otherwise stage/status and clear cancellation where supported.
recipes.acceptance_test: Users understand whether work continues and can recover from failure.
recipes.failure_modes: Invented percentages or intentionally added delay.

recipes.when_to_use: Out-of-order queries overwrite newer results
recipes.implementation: Associate requests with current query/version, discard stale results and preserve visible context.
recipes.acceptance_test: Slow prior response never overwrites newer selection.
recipes.failure_modes: Racing transitions and flickering results.

recipes.when_to_use: Unskippable slides block real use
recipes.implementation: Show a first achievable task, one primary action and optional contextual help; use a safe sample where relevant.
recipes.acceptance_test: Novice reaches first real value without reading tour.
recipes.failure_modes: Hiding material consent or safety constraints.

recipes.when_to_use: Instructions are forgotten by moment of use
recipes.implementation: Associate concise help with control and error, provide revisitable help and user dismiss control.
recipes.acceptance_test: When stuck, users locate guidance at point of need.
recipes.failure_modes: Intrusive repeated popovers and focus loss.

recipes.when_to_use: Novices overwhelmed but expert paths hidden
recipes.implementation: Expose beginner basics and findable advanced tools, templates and keyboard shortcuts.
recipes.acceptance_test: Novice succeeds and expert retains efficient path.
recipes.failure_modes: Hiding features permanently or forcing tutorial resets.

recipes.when_to_use: Users lose progress across sessions
recipes.implementation: Persist meaningful draft securely, show save status and explicit resume/discard controls.
recipes.acceptance_test: After interruption user resumes at correct step and can discard.
recipes.failure_modes: False saved state or coercive unfinished reminders.

recipes.when_to_use: Publish, delete or pay creates anxiety
recipes.implementation: State consequence, preview salient effects, allow correction, confirm durable outcome and show recovery.
recipes.acceptance_test: User understands the irreversible action and its final status.
recipes.failure_modes: Celebratory UI masking errors.

recipes.when_to_use: Team optimizes screens while task fails end to end
recipes.implementation: Map entry, decisions, waiting, errors, handoffs and completion; rank by harm, frequency and persistence.
recipes.acceptance_test: Top tasks improve and severe minority failures get addressed.
recipes.failure_modes: Using 80/20 to dismiss accessibility and security cases.

recipes.when_to_use: Visual framing coerces acceptance
recipes.implementation: Present costs and alternatives openly, use neutral option language and symmetric access to decline/cancel.
recipes.acceptance_test: Users can explain consequences and complete opt-out.
recipes.failure_modes: Dark patterns disguised as defaults.

recipes.when_to_use: Permission requested without scope or revocation path
recipes.implementation: Explain specific data use and consequences before commitment, preserve refusal, support later reversal where required.
recipes.acceptance_test: Users know what they agreed to and can revoke appropriately.
recipes.failure_modes: Prechecked sensitive permission or hidden usage.

recipes.when_to_use: Attractive completion masks uncertain backend state
recipes.implementation: Tie confirmations to durable receipts, distinguish pending, failed and complete, show next steps.
recipes.acceptance_test: User can verify transaction state and recover from uncertainty.
recipes.failure_modes: Fake success animation and missing status.

recipes.when_to_use: Keyboard user cannot operate component
recipes.implementation: Use semantic control, correct tab/arrow behavior, focused overlay/return focus, visible outline, no trap.
recipes.acceptance_test: All essential tasks complete keyboard-only and with assistive tech.
recipes.failure_modes: Role added without functionality.

recipes.when_to_use: Color or motion is sole indicator
recipes.implementation: Pair state color with text/icon/accessible announcement; honor reduced motion; inspect contrast/reflow.
recipes.acceptance_test: State understandable in grayscale, high zoom and reduced motion.
recipes.failure_modes: Overactive live regions or icon-only meaning.

recipes.when_to_use: Tiny controls require precision/drag
recipes.implementation: Apply target size and spacing rules with exceptions, expose non-drag alternative, preserve semantics.
recipes.acceptance_test: Pointer and keyboard users can reach action without erroneous activation.
recipes.failure_modes: Assuming 44px required for all WCAG AA targets.
